issues.description: Duplicate React imports in apps/web/app/auth/page.tsx — useEffect and useState are imported twice (lines 2 and 5), causing a compile error that breaks Fast Refresh for the entire app.
issues.root_cause: Two import statements from 'react' exist: line 2 has `import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'` and line 5 has `import { FormEvent, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react'`, causing duplicate identifier errors.

issues.description: React hydration errors on step-1 page — 'Text content does not match server-rendered HTML' repeated multiple times, causing the entire root to switch to client rendering. Likely caused by dynamic/random values (e.g. particle positions or timestamps) computed during SSR that differ on client.
issues.element: apps/web/app/design/step-1/page.tsx — particle canvas or dynamic text
issues.root_cause: Any Math.random() or Date.now() calls or non-deterministic values rendered during SSR will mismatch on hydration. The particle animation or any dynamically generated content without 'use client' or suppressHydrationWarning causes this.

issues.description: Invalid or unexpected token error in console — indicates a syntax error in one of the source files, possibly introduced by a bad edit.
issues.element: Unknown source file with syntax error
issues.root_cause: A file in the app contains an invalid token (likely a stray character, bad template literal, or malformed JSX). Most likely in apps/web/app/auth/page.tsx given recent edits.

fixes.new_str:
import { Cormorant_Garamond, Manrope } from "next/font/google";
import { FormEvent, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
fixes.reason: Remove the duplicate React import on line 2 that re-declares useEffect and useState, resolving the compile error.
Add suppressHydrationWarning to the canvas element to prevent hydration mismatch errors caused by particle animation values differing between SSR and client render.
